keys: # 房间、平板、场所、地下居民区、科技树（房间线程，2026-11-19）。都是临时文字，策划定了再换，编号不变。

zh: 一本翻旧了的《地球植物图鉴》，书角写着：等我长大，要亲手种一棵。
en: A worn copy of "Plants of Earth". In the corner: when I grow up, I'll plant one myself.

zh: 书架上是方舟学校发的课本：机械、生态、通信，还有一本没有封面的旧童话。
en: Textbooks from the Ark school: mechanics, ecology, comms. And an old fairy tale with no cover.

zh: 挂册里贴着方舟各层的照片。最后一页是一张地球的老照片：蓝色的海，白色的云。
en: Photos of every deck of the Ark. The last page is an old photo of Earth: blue sea, white clouds.

zh: 一株小小的豆苗，罩在透明灯罩里。灯罩替它挡住舱内干燥的空气。
en: A tiny bean sprout under a clear cover that keeps the dry cabin air away.

zh: 她照着说明书拼的 ARK-01 模型，有一只机械臂装反了，她说这样更可爱。
en: The ARK-01 model she built from the manual. One arm is on backwards, and she says it's cuter that way.

zh: 窗外是现在选的景色。可以在平板里换。
en: Whatever view you picked. You can change it on the tablet.

zh: 点房间里的东西可以互动，右键退出近看。
en: Click things in the room. Right-click to step back.

zh: 一个小小的全息地球仪，转得很慢。她说等小镇修好了，要把它标成绿色。
en: A small holo globe, spinning slowly. She says she'll mark the town green once it's fixed.

zh: 恢复度：生态 {plants}　清理 {ruins}　电力 {power}　水 {water}

keys: # RM-04 周记（她写的，按周和她现在的性格挑句子）

zh: 今天又发现了一个不懂的东西。不懂的东西越多，我越想知道。
en: I found something I don't understand again. The more I don't know

zh: ARK-01 的灯一闪一闪的，好像在难过。我想它也会累吧。
en: ARK-01's light kept flickering, like it was sad. Maybe it gets tired too.

zh: 我这周做成了一件事。原来我可以。
en: I got something done this week. Turns out I can.

zh: 这周平平常常的，没有特别想写的。
en: This week was ordinary. Nothing special to write.

zh: 我的朋友是 ARK-01。它不会说话，但它每次都会回头等我。
en: My friend is ARK-01. It can't talk, but it always turns back to wait for me.

zh: 第一周：开始上课了。机械课的老师说话好快。
en: Week 1: classes started. The mechanics teacher talks so fast.

zh: 第二周：游戏里的小镇好安静，只有风声。
en: Week 2: the town in the game is so quiet, just wind.

zh: 第三周：广场边上居然长出了一棵草！
en: Week 3: a plant is growing at the edge of the square!

zh: 第四周：大门开了。门后面是什么呢？
en: Week 4: the gate opened. What's behind it?

zh: 第五周：有人来过的脚印。是谁？
en: Week 5: footprints. Someone was here. Who?

zh: 第六周：桥修好了。我站在桥上，像站在真的地球上。
en: Week 6: the bridge is fixed. Standing on it felt like standing on the real Earth.

zh: 第七周：我们要去地下了。
地球的恢复度到了 {value}。好像比上周绿了一点点。
en: Earth recovery is at {value}. A tiny bit greener than last week.

zh: 小镇还没开放，我只能在窗边想象它的样子。
en: The town isn't open yet, so I imagine it from the window.

zh: {player} 总是听我说话。我很高兴有你。
en: {player} always listens to me. I'm glad you're here.

zh: {player} 今天又替我决定了。我不太高兴。
en: {player} decided for me again today. I'm not happy about it.

zh: {player} 是怎样的人呢？我还在想。
en: What kind of person is {player}? I'm still figuring it out.

zh: A / D 或方向键沿过道走，点发光的东西看说明。
en: A / D or arrow keys to walk, click glowing things to read.

zh: 机械室：她在这里上机械课。墙上挂满了工具，桌上是拆开的旧电机。
en: Machine Room: where she takes mechanics class. Tools on every wall, an old motor taken apart on the bench.

zh: 工作台上的旧电机。老师说，修东西前要先听它哪里在响。
en: An old motor on the bench. The teacher says: before you fix it, listen to where it hurts.

zh: 一排排的工具，每一把都刻着上一个使用者的名字。
en: Rows of tools, each engraved with the name of the person who used it before.

zh: 温室：她在这里上生态课。方舟上所有的绿色都在这里。
en: Greenhouse: where she takes ecology class. All the green on the Ark lives here.

zh: 水培架上的生菜，叶子在灯下几乎透明。
en: Lettuce on hydroponic racks, almost see-through under the lamps.

zh: 种子库的小柜子，上面写着：留给地球。
en: A small seed vault. The label says: for Earth.

zh: 通讯室：她在这里上通信课。屏幕上是地球传回的雪花信号。
en: Comms Room: where she takes comms class. The screens show static from Earth.

zh: 一台旧收发器，天线断过一次，又被接上了。
en: An old transceiver. The antenna broke once, and someone fixed it.

zh: 屏幕上的信号图。偶尔有一段规律的波，没人知道是什么。
en: A signal chart. Sometimes there's a regular wave nobody can explain.

zh: 人类保护区：胚胎和休眠的人都在这里。只能沿着过道看，不能靠近。
en: Human Preserve: embryos and sleepers rest here. You can only look from the walkway.

zh: 一排排休眠舱，玻璃上结着薄霜。每个舱上都有一个名字。
en: Rows of sleep pods, frost on the glass. Every pod has a name.

zh: 胚胎库的指示灯一闪一闪，像很多很小的心跳。
en: The embryo vault's lights blink, like many tiny heartbeats.

zh: 过道尽头的牌子：等地球准备好，我们就回家。
en: A sign at the end of the walkway: when Earth is ready, we go home.

keys: # RM-09 主界面（11.19 按参考图"方舟生活"改版）
# RM-07 地下居民区（第 7 周；世界观没定，先用临时文字）

zh: ARK-01 跟着幸存者走下长长的阶梯。黑暗的尽头，亮起了灯。
en: ARK-01 follows the survivor down a long stairway. At the end of the dark, lights come on.

zh: 用旧管道拼成的水渠，水声在洞里回响。他们自己把水引了下来。
en: A channel built from old pipes, water echoing in the cave. They brought the water down themselves.

zh: 一片用镜子把地面阳光引下来的菜地。叶子很小，但都活着。
en: A garden lit by mirrors that bring sunlight down from above. Small leaves, but all alive.

zh: 墙上画满了孩子的画：太阳、树、还有一个长得像 ARK-01 的机器人。
en: Children's drawings cover the wall: the sun, trees, and a robot that looks like ARK-01.

zh: 洞顶挂着一盏盏手工做的灯，像地下的星星。
en: Handmade lamps hang from the ceiling, like stars underground.

zh: 一块刻满名字的石碑。最下面一行是新刻的，还很浅。
en: A stone carved with names. The newest line at the bottom is still shallow.

zh: 她小声说：原来……一直有人在这里活着。
en: She whispers: so... people were living here all along.

keys: # RM-08 科技（女孩技能值够了自动解锁）

zh: 她的技能够了就会自动解锁。
en: Unlocks automatically when her skills are high enough.

zh: ARK-01 能修好断开的零件。
能建发电设备，范围内通电。
en: Can build generators that power the area.

zh: ARK-01 的机械臂更稳，施工更快。（展示用，暂不改数值）
en: ARK-01's arm is steadier, building goes faster. (Display only for now)

zh: 扫描时能看出哪里的土还能种东西。
en: Scans show which soil can still grow things.

zh: 能建净水站，产出清洁水。
en: Can build purifiers for clean water.

zh: 能建土壤改良器，每周降低污染。
en: Can build soil improvers that lower pollution.

zh: 能听懂地球传回的一部分信号。
en: Can understand some of the signals from Earth.

zh: 能建通信中继，扩大可操作范围。
en: Can build relays to extend range.

zh: 能和更远的地方说话。（展示用，暂不改数值）
en: Can talk to places farther away. (Display only for now)
